silent_decisions.decision: no overdrafts (balance may not go below 0)
repeated txn id with a different payload is acknowledged and ignored
unknown account reads as balance 0 instead of an error
open() on an existing account is a silent no-op (not an error, not a reset)
amount is validated before rounding: a positive amount below half a cent is accepted and recorded as 0
insufficient funds is checked before the daily limit
transfers do not count toward the daily withdrawal limit
a rejected operation consumes neither its txnId nor daily-limit allowance

not_implemented.what: transfer to the same account is not rejected

decided_by_the_plan: history entry per accepted operation (plan P-008)
